title: federation-server: Peer/groupUpdate rejects or normalizes ChatMember roles other than admin/member
description: Compliance §1.9 (doc:83) and §13.3 (doc:711): "send a member with role: owner. Verify the server either rejects it or normalizes to member. The only valid values are admin and member." group_update.rs check_members validates only id and invitedBy. Size S. From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
